_validation_note: 14-day window candidates C1 and C2 both failed multiple gates. Broadening window applied to C3-C6; all four also failed. No mechanism passed all seven gates. Specific failures: C1 (NSF SBIR/STTR Restart) — Gate 1 fails because the only live news trigger is an NSF.gov press release (nsf.gov/news/), which the gate explicitly excludes; no independent news outlet article covering this mechanism could be verified via WebFetch. Gate 3 also fails: congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/senate-bill/3971 returns HTTP 403 (S.3971 statutory text unverifiable). Gate 5 fails: the claimed chokepoint (NSF TIP Program Officers) is an anonymous role pool, not a publicly named institutional actor. C2 (APFC FY27 IPS CIO Commitment Stack) — Gate 1 passes (BriefGlance May 29, 2026 confirmed live). Gate 3 fails: apfc.org/investment-team-leadership names Frampton as CIO but documents NO individual PE commitment authority ranges; apfc.org/the-fund/asset-class-portfolios/private-equity names no Allen Waldrop and documents no CIO or Deputy CIO individual commitment authority. The critical claimed chokepoint (CIO binary authority at $25M-$100M per deal without board vote) cannot be traced to any fetched primary source. Gate 5 fails for the same reason. Gate 7 is a concurrent concern: APFC IPS has been dropped in multiple prior runs on diffuse_chokepoint grounds; the CIO-authority reframing fails at Gate 3 before Gate 7 is reached. C3 (HB126 ANC Disclosure Exemption) — Gate 1 fails: the KYUK news trigger is dated May 14, one day before the 21-day broadening window opens (May 15); no independent news article within the May 15-June 5 window could be verified via WebFetch. Gate 4 fails independently: the 12 AI-active regional ANCs (CIRI, Doyon, Koniag) are explicitly NOT affected by HB126; only village corps with fewer than 500 founding shareholders are in scope; the Alaska AI industry consequence is therefore inferential, not direct. C4 (Kenai LNG Terminal Reconversion) — Gate 5 fails: FERC Commission vote requires a 5-member majority under 42 U.S.C. section 7171. No alternative single-actor chokepoint could be verified. C5 (FCC USF Suspension and Debarment) — Gate 1 fails: all ADN/ProPublica trigger URLs return HTTP 404. Gate 3 fails: fcc.gov returns HTTP 503. Gate 5 fails: SDO not publicly named. C6 (CIRI ANC Technology Acquisition Stack) — Gate 5 fails: CIRI CEO sub-board-threshold individual acquisition authority not documented in any fetchable primary source.
